<div style="text-align:center"><div style="width:8.5in;text-align:left;margin-left: auto;margin-right: auto">

<table style="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt;border-spacing:0;width:100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">
<tr style="page-break-inside:avoid">
<td style="width:11%;vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><span style="font-weight:bold">Item&#8201;1.01</span></td>
<td style="vertical-align:top;text-align:left"> <p style=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:bold;text-align:left">Entry into a Material Definitive Agreement. </p></td></tr></table> <p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><span style="font-style:italic">Completion of Distribution </span></p> <p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">On October&#160;26, 2026, MSG Knickerbockers Corp. (formerly Madison Square Garden Sports Corp. and referred herein as &#8220;MSG Knicks&#8221;) effected the distribution (the &#8220;Distribution&#8221;) of all of the issued and outstanding shares of the common stock of MSG Rangers Corp. (formerly MSGS Spinco, Inc., and referred to herein as the &#8220;Company&#8221;). In the Distribution, (a)&#160;each holder of MSG Knicks Class&#160;A common stock, par value $0.01 per share (&#8220;MSG Knicks Class&#160;A Common Stock&#8221;), received one share of the Company&#8217;s Class&#160;A common stock, par value $0.01 per share (&#8220;Company Class&#160;A Common Stock&#8221;), for every two shares of MSG Knicks Class&#160;A Common Stock held of record as of the close of business, New York City time, on October&#160;20, 2026 (the &#8220;Record Date&#8221;) and (b)&#160;each holder of MSG Knicks Class&#160;B common stock, par value $0.01 per share (&#8220;MSG Knicks Class&#160;B Common Stock&#8221;), received one share of the Company&#8217;s Class&#160;B common stock, par value $0.01 per share (&#8220;Company Class&#160;B Common Stock&#8221;) for every two shares of MSG Knicks Class&#160;B Common Stock held of record as of the close of business, New York City time, on the Record Date. In the Distribution, an aggregate of 9,794,568 shares of Company Class&#160;A Common Stock and 2,264,754 shares of Company Class&#160;B Common Stock were distributed, with any fractional shares converted to cash and paid to stockholders. In addition, in connection with the Distribution, 46,005 shares of Company Class&#160;A Common Stock were distributed in respect of MSG Knicks <span style="white-space:nowrap">non-employee</span> director restricted stock units to the applicable holders as of the Record Date. </p> <p style="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><span style="font-style:italic">NHL Transfer Consent Agreement </span></p> <p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">On October&#160;23, 2026, MSG Knicks, the Company and certain of their subsidiaries entered into a Transfer Consent Agreement with the National Hockey League (&#8220;NHL&#8221;) pursuant to which the parties acknowledge that future transfers of the ownership of the New York Rangers hockey club (the &#8220;Rangers&#8221;), the location of the Rangers or certain other transfers of assets or ownership, subject to exceptions, will require the consent of the NHL. The Company parties and MSG Knicks parties also agreed to release the NHL entities from any claims against them. </p> <p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The description above is qualified in its entirety by reference to the Transfer Consent Agreement, which is attached as Exhibits 10.1 to this Current Report on Form <span style="white-space:nowrap">8-K</span> and incorporated into this Item 1.01 by reference. </p> <p style="font-size:18pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</p>
<table style="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt;border-spacing:0;width:100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">
<tr style="page-break-inside:avoid">
<td style="width:11%;vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><span style="font-weight:bold">Item&#8201;5.02</span></td>
<td style="vertical-align:top;text-align:left"> <p style=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:bold;text-align:left">Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers. </p></td></tr></table> <p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">On October&#160;26, 2026, Alan D. Schwartz and Hans Vestberg were appointed to serve as members of the Audit Committee of the Company&#8217;s Board of Directors (the &#8220;Board&#8221;), and Mr.&#160;Schwartz was appointed as Chair of the Audit Committee. </p> <p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Also on October&#160;26, 2026, Stephen C. Mills and Mr.&#160;Vestberg were appointed to serve as members of the Compensation Committee of the Board, and Joseph M. Cohen was appointed as Chair of the Compensation Committee. </p> <p style="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><span style="font-style:italic">Approval of Executive Deferred Compensation Plan </span></p> <p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Effective as of October&#160;26, 2026, the Board approved the MSG Rangers Corp. Executive Deferred Compensation Plan, (the &#8220;EDCP&#8221;), pursuant to which certain employees, including the Company&#8217;s named executive officers, may elect to participate. </p> <p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Pursuant to the EDCP, participants may make elective base salary or bonus deferral contributions. Participants may make individual investment elections that will determine the rate of return on their deferral amounts under the EDCP. The EDCP does not provide any above-market returns or preferential earnings to participants, and the participants&#8217; deferrals and their earnings are always 100% vested. The EDCP does not provide for any Company contributions. Participants may elect at the time they make their deferral elections to receive their distribution either as a lump sum payment or in substantially equal annual installments over a period of 5 years. </p> <p style="font-size:18pt; margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</p>
</div></div>

 <p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The description above is qualified in its entirety by reference to the EDCP, which is attached as Exhibit 10.2 hereto and incorporated into this Item&#160;5.02 by reference. </p> <p style="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><span style="font-style:italic">Employment Agreements </span></p> <p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">On October&#160;26, 2026, the Company entered into the previously-disclosed employment agreements with James L. Dolan, David Granville-Smith, Paul DiCicco and Jamaal T. Lesane, effective as of the Distribution. The description above is qualified in its entirety by reference to the employment agreements with James L. Dolan, David Granville-Smith, Paul DiCicco and Jamaal T. Lesane, which are attached as Exhibits 10.3, 10.4, 10.5 and 10.6, respectively, to this Current Report on Form <span style="white-space:nowrap">8-K</span> and incorporated into this Item 5.02 by reference, and are substantially in the forms included as Exhibit 10.23, Exhibit 10.24, Exhibit 10.25 and Exhibit 10.26, respectively, to the Form 10. </p> <p style="font-size:18pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</p>

<td style="width:11%;vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><span style="font-weight:bold">Item&#8201;5.03</span></td>

The above description is qualified in its entirety by reference to the Certificate of Amendment, which is attached as Exhibit 3.1 to this Current Report on Form <span style="white-space:nowrap">8-K</span> and incorporated into this Item 5.03 by reference. </p> <p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Also on October&#160;26, 2026, the Company&#8217;s Amended and Restated Bylaws (the &#8220;A&amp;R Bylaws&#8221;) became effective immediately prior to the Distribution. The A&amp;R Bylaws are attached as Exhibit 3.2 to this Current Report on Form <span style="white-space:nowrap">8-K,</span> are incorporated into this Item 5.03 by reference, and are substantially in the form included as Exhibit 3.4 to the Company&#8217;s registration statement on Form 10 (the &#8220;Form 10&#8221;). </p> <p style="font-size:18pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</p>

Dolan Children Trusts (the &#8220;Children Trusts Registration Rights Agreement&#8221;), (ii) a Registration Rights Agreement, dated October&#160;2, 2026, with The Dolan Family Affiliates (as defined therein) (the &#8220;Dolan Registration Rights Agreement&#8221;), and (iii)&#160;a Standstill Agreement, dated October&#160;2, 2026, with the Dolan Family Group (the &#8220;Standstill Agreement&#8221;), each as further described in the Form 10. The Children Trusts Registration Rights Agreement, the Dolan Registration Rights Agreement and the Standstill Agreement are attached as Exhibit 4.1, Exhibit 4.2 and Exhibit 10.7, respectively, to this Current Report on Form <span style="white-space:nowrap">8-K,</span> are incorporated into this Item 8.01 by reference, and are substantially in the forms included as Exhibit 4.1, Exhibit 4.2 and Exhibit 10.6, respectively, to the Form 10. </p> <p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Also in connection with the Distribution, on October&#160;26, 2026, the Company&#8217;s outside counsel delivered a tax opinion to MSG Knicks. A copy of such opinion is filed as Exhibit 8.1 to this Current Report on Form <span style="white-space:nowrap">8-K,</span> is incorporated into this Item 8.01 by reference, and is substantially in the form previously included as Exhibit 8.1 to the Form 10. </p> <p style="font-size:12pt; margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</p>
